share.title: Share local content
share.pickHint: Choose content to collaborate on. It stays in its original location, and edits sync to members in real time.
share.sharingHint: Pausing local editing, uploading attachments, and creating the shared document. Keep the app open.
share.doneHint: Send the collaboration code to the other person. Their request will appear in notifications and the sidebar.
share.emptyHint: Enter keywords to search articles, cards, project documents, journals, or whiteboards
board.activeHint: Edit the whiteboard on its page; changes sync to members automatically. To end sharing or leave, use the members button at the bottom right of the whiteboard.
board.closedHint: Sharing has ended for this whiteboard.
